title: Recovering Vault Shackles (Alliance)
wikitext: {{Questbox | name=Recovering Vault Shackles | start=[[Koli Steamheart]] | faction=Alliance | id= | level=63 | type=Dungeon | category=Stormwind Vault | reputation = +350 [[Stormwind (faction)|Stormwind]] | experience = 6500 | rewards = }} == Objectives == Within the Stormwind Vault, slay Runic Constructs for 2 Runic Shackles, return them to Koli Steamheart. * [[Runic Shackle]] (2) == Description == Back when the Vault first was opened, it was used to house the most dangerous prisoners, to contain magical entities and the insane alike, we used Runic Constructs to patrol the hallways! These Runic Constructs have fallen corrupt from the intense magic within the Vault, and need to be destroyed, their powerful bracers are what keep them intact, and they need to be recovered! I have plans to test what exactly went wrong with these bracers. You can find them within the Stormwind Vault, slay them, and bring me a pair of Shackles, I will make sure you are rewarded for the task. ==Rewards== * 6500 XP == Progress == Be careful, the Runic Constructs are quite powerful, an overchage of magical energy gone rampant! == Completion == Ahh, here we are! This is them, thanks again, this means a lot, here, just as I promised. ==Notes== ;Upon completion :'''Koli Steamheart says:''' Thanks again for the help! I will make sure to study these so the same thing cannot happen again!
